caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular object resembling a quilt or textile with a geometric pattern composed of hexagons. The interior features seven large, multi-layered hexagonal clusters arranged in a honeycomb pattern. Each cluster has a small hexagon at its center and is surrounded by concentric rings of hexagons in alternating colors, including yellow, orange, green, blue, pink, and red. These clusters are interlocked with gray-bordered hexagons, which separate the colorful clusters from one another. The entire patterned area is framed by three borders: a thin pink inner border, a thicker gray middle border, and a thin black outer border. The colors are bright and varied, and all lines and shapes are rendered in colored pencil on a beige background. The object is set against a plain, uncolored backdrop.
title: Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
